notes: Immortal Empires feature image - the PRIMARY boundary line network for S3a. It is the same map as the parchment master with the lettering removed, which matters more than it sounds: on the master, a place name lying across a border merges the two cells either side of it, and no amount of inpainting fully recovers a boundary that was never drawn under the text. Here there is no text to occlude anything, so the cell network comes out closed. It costs coverage - the crop drops the polar Chaos Wastes, the far Eastern Steppes and the eastern edge of Cathay - which is exactly the gap the master is kept registered to fill, at lower precedence. Higher boundary precedence than the master (50 vs 40) for that reason. Contributes no coastline: the committed land mask is the coastline authority.
